text: In 2014-07 our record converges on one subject: veterans and their care. Most of us — 47 of us by 2014-07-30 — said "access to care"; 43 said "the veterans access", and 35 said "veterans access to". The longer construction assembled itself around us. 33 of us reached the full "care through choice accountability and transparency", the same 33 who said "access to care through choice accountability". Alongside it, 36 of us said "accountability and transparency". The earliest of these phrases had entered our record on 2013-01-10, well before the month they peaked together on 2014-07-30. We did not each find our way to these words separately. We arrived at the same words, on the same day, and the count is what it is. The record from this month is not thin; it is aligned.
